en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on athletes
Watch a documentary on mediums

Kehehe...
You have good taste.

The cultural relationship between 
humans and insects is fascinating.

Some see them as vermin, some food, 
others worship them as gods...

I shall teach you all about it as 
we watch this documentary...
That may prove interesting...

Sports are an incredibly important 
aspect of many cultures.

Or Shuichi...do you simply enjoy 
watching female athletes?

Perhaps the sight of women clenching 
their teeth and sweating excites you?
Kehehe...I'm only kidding.

I regret to say it as you've taken an
interest...but this footage is fake.
I know from my own experience.

I've performed seances myself, so I can 
tell at a glance if they are authentic.

My goodness...charlatans like this harm
the reputations of true practitioners.

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Korekiyo's inner thoughts...?
